    1. flatMap(Function)

Schnittstelle Bindable<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A>

Typparameter:
WT - the witness type of the implementing HKT (see WitnessType)
A - the carried value type
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Either<L,R>, Eval<A>, Maybe<A>, Monadic<WT,A>, Provider<A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Attempt, Either.Left, Either.Right, Eval.Always, Eval.Later, Eval.Now, Maybe.None, Maybe.Some
public interface Bindable<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A>

Monad‑like flatMap (monadic bind) contract for rank‑1 higher‑kinded types (HKTs). It enables sequencing of operations that produce values of the same HKT shape by applying a transformation to the carried value and returning a new HKT instance.

The WT witness encodes the type constructor; A is the carried value type. Implementations are expected to be null‑safe: the transformation function must not be null and must not return null.

  • Methodendetails

    • flatMap

      <B> @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<? extends WT, B> flatMap(@NonNull Function<? super A, ? extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<? extends WT, B>> transformation)

      Applies the given transformation to the carried value and returns a new HKT instance of the same constructor shape. This operation supports fluent chaining of computations that depend on the previous result (monadic bind).

      Contract: the transformation must not be null and must not return null.

      Typparameter:
      B - the new carried value type
      Parameter:
      transformation - the function to transform the carried value into a new Higher1 of the same witness
      Gibt zurück:
      a Higher1 with the transformed value; never null
